author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a test's per-case data-fetching logic in the test body, not duplicated inside each scorer; give scorers a reusable, declarative way to query and assert.
fix_shape: move db queries to the test body, pass results to scorers, and build a shared scorer helper/DSL.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: When a bug's root cause is a diagnosed and already-fixed-upstream issue, wait for that fix to ship rather than layering additional client-side workarounds that have already been shown ineffective.
fix_shape: revert/avoid the added mitigation; document the true root cause and link the upstream fix instead of retrying client-side.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: When removing a mechanism, also remove the code that existed only to support it, rather than leaving it dead.
fix_shape: delete the now-unused constant/helper alongside the mechanism it supported.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Record the diagnosed root cause of a measurement or experiment in the docs, not just the raw null result, so the next reader does not have to re-derive it.
fix_shape: add a short explanation of the cause and link the upstream issue/fix next to the measurement.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When introducing a better replacement for an internal API you own end to end, make the change breaking and remove the old path rather than keeping both as optional.
fix_shape: delete the old method/overload and update all call sites to the new one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reference another entity by a Ref rather than a raw id, and add a test that the consuming path dereferences it correctly.
fix_shape: change the field's type to Ref<T> and cover ref resolution with a test.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose test-observable state (e.g. captured trace messages) through an Effect Layer plus a Context tag the test can request, rather than an ad hoc closure-based collector.
fix_shape: wrap the collector in a Layer keyed by a Context.Tag with a typed accessor.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse a shared test helper/service across every suite that needs the same behavior instead of re-implementing it per file.
fix_shape: import and use the shared test service in the other test suites.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a cache in front of an operation that is already cheap; do the direct computation instead.
fix_shape: remove the cache map and perform the plain transform inline.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove small single-use helper functions and inline their logic instead of adding indirection for its own sake.
fix_shape: delete the helper functions and write their bodies inline at the call site.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Don't add explanatory comments that just restate configuration already legible from the code/name; keep comments only where they carry reasoning the code can't express.
fix_shape: delete the unnecessary comment.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A batch operation's 'success' must never silently discard entries that failed; surface every failure to the caller.
fix_shape: collect the failed results from a settled Promise.all/batch and propagate or report them instead of swallowing them.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't implement ordered, sequential processing with a hand-rolled promise chain (racy around lifecycle); use a purpose-built ordering primitive.
fix_shape: replace the manual promise-chaining queue with a TransformStream (or equivalent) that processes items strictly in order.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer native web platform APIs over Node-specific ones in code that must run in non-Node environments.
fix_shape: replace Node Buffer usage with the equivalent web API (e.g. Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Never use a fixed sleep/timeout to wait for async state to settle in a test; wait on a deterministic signal instead.
fix_shape: replace the sleep with awaiting the actual condition/event rather than a fixed delay.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Process a collection of async work with a bounded-concurrency combinator rather than an unbounded sequential loop.
fix_shape: replace the for-loop with Effect.forEach(items, fn, { concurrency: N }).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't introduce a second, ad hoc piece of lifecycle/torn-down state when the class already owns one lifecycle mechanism; reuse and normalize naming instead of adding a parallel flag.
fix_shape: derive the state from (or normalize naming with) the existing base-class lifecycle instead of a new private flag.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a type cast to work around a type mismatch; find or build a type-safe way to satisfy the signature.
fix_shape: remove the cast and adjust generics/types so the call is properly typed.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Wrap a stateful message-channel pattern (subscribe/post) in its own small utility class with named handlers and post methods, rather than scattering raw channel/message-type usage inline.
fix_shape: extract a class encapsulating the channel, listener registration, and message posting.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Give a new, logically separate store/index its own class/module rather than folding it into an unrelated existing index's code.
fix_shape: create a dedicated class for the new store in the appropriate directory, with its own name/cursor, instead of embedding it in an unrelated file.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse an existing generic mechanism already built for a need (e.g. a cursors table for re-indexing) rather than introducing extra machinery.
fix_shape: drive the new behavior through the existing shared table/mechanism instead of a bespoke one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: An eval or test exercising an agent end-to-end should drive the real agent doing the real task, not a scripted stand-in, and should verify specific tool calls by inspecting the actual invocation transcript.
fix_shape: replace the scripted flow with a real agent run guided by a prescriptive script, and assert on parsed transcript tool calls.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't write a custom helper that duplicates behavior an official/library API already provides; use the official API directly.
fix_shape: delete the local helper and call the library's built-in function instead.
